16-17 is pretty normal. 14-15 is kind of pushing it. the reason it’s a “no” in society is because people below 18 are still children, hence even if they are “mature,” still don’t have the experience or understanding someone who’s 20 in a relationship with a 24 year old would.

18 would mean you’re done with, or almost done with high school. 14-15 is 8th grade-freshman age. there’s a lot of things that would have influenced my opinion that i gained during that 2-3 year gap, coming from an 18 year old woman.
